packageRules.description: The packageManager pin is toolchain, so non-major updates merge themselves.
The toolchain pins (mise, nvm) move with packageManager, so they merge themselves too.

devDependencies only: patch and minor merge themselves once CI is green. Runtime dependencies, peerDependencies and every major stay manual — this repo publishes a toolchain other packages install, so a bump there is a consumer-visible change someone should choose.
